title: US-Mediated Russia-Ukraine Talks Resume in Abu Dhabi
detail: Russian and Ukrainian delegations met in Abu Dhabi on Nov 10 for the first talks since February, with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner mediating. Ukraine's delegation was led by Rustem Umerov and Russia's by Vladimir Medinsky. The agenda centred on security guarantees; territory remains the main sticking point. A second day was scheduled for Nov 11; no outcome had been reported at the time of this update.

media.caption: US attempts new peace push with first Russia-Ukraine talks in nine months
